```{r}
db <- dati |>
  dplyr::filter(anno == 1973) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Lon10", "Lat10"), crs = 4326)

```

I work on a spatial data on rainfall and have measures from several stations in Italy. In my database there is a variable for the total amount of rain in the year

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = db, aes(color = totanno)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c()
```

```{r}
cor.test(db$totanno,db$Quota)
ggplot(data = db, aes(x = Quota, y = totanno)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, colour = "red")
```

```{r}
choose_idw_p <- function(coords, z,
                         p_grid = seq(0.5, 6, by = 0.25),
                         nmax = Inf) {
  
  stopifnot(nrow(coords) == length(z))
  n <- length(z)
  
  dat <- data.frame(x = coords[, 1], y = coords[, 2], z = z)
  pts <- st_as_sf(dat, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = NA)
  
  # LOO predictions for a given p
  loo_mse <- function(p) {
    pred <- numeric(n)
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      out <- idw(z ~ 1,
                 locations = pts[-i, ],
                 newdata   = pts[i, ],
                 idp       = p,
                 nmax      = nmax,
                 debug.level = 0)
      pred[i] <- out$var1.pred
    }
    mean((z - pred)^2)
  }
  
  mse <- vapply(p_grid, loo_mse, numeric(1))
  res <- data.frame(p = p_grid, MSE = mse)
  best_p <- res$p[which.min(res$MSE)]
  
  plt <- ggplot(res, aes(p, MSE)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_point(data = res[res$p == best_p, ], colour = "red", size = 3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = best_p, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
    labs(title = "Leave-one-out MSE for IDW",
         subtitle = paste0("Best p = ", best_p,
                           " (MSE = ", signif(min(res$MSE), 4), ")"),
         x = "Power parameter p", y = "LOO MSE") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  list(best_p = best_p, mse = res, plot = plt)
}

xy <- st_coordinates(db)

out <- choose_idw_p(coords = xy,
                    z      = db$totanno,
                    p_grid = seq(0.5, 6, by = 0.25))

out$best_p   # optimal p
out$mse      # table of p vs MSE
out$plot
```

db_utm  <- st_transform(db, 32632)
grid_sf <- st_as_sf(grid, coords = c("XUTM", "YUTM"), crs = 32632)
idw_out <- idw(totanno ~ 1, locations = db_utm, newdata = grid_sf, idp = out$best_p)

idw_df <- cbind(st_drop_geometry(idw_out), st_coordinates(idw_out))

ggplot() +
